$comment: Unity's native (C++) object layouts that raid-actions reads (read-only) to place UI elements on screen. Not in the IL2CPP dump:
worked out by hand on the running game with 'RaidActions probe' (2026-10-26, Unity 6000.3.18f1, Raid 11.85.5).
Re-check after a game or Unity update (probe views / probe dump); the reader refuses when the build differs.
Each entry says how it was established. 'verified' = confirmed against something independent; 'unverified' = consistent so far.

gameObject.how: VillageHUD's native MonoBehaviour+0x20 = the GameObject whose component list holds that MonoBehaviour

managedSlot.how: native+0x18 points at a slot holding the managed object (VillageHUD: slot -> the same managed DialogView)

components.how: dynamic_array data: 16-byte pairs {int typeIndex; Component*}; VillageHUD's view is entry 5

componentCount.how: dynamic_array size (11), capacity 22 at +0x38, memory label 58 at +0x28

activeSelf.how: VillageHUD 1 -> 0 when the Arena opened; its children kept 1

activeInHierarchy.how: VillageHUD's children 0 while their parent was inactive, 1 before

name.how: char* to the GameObject name ('[DV] VillageHUD', 'Workspace', ...)

rectTransformTypeIndex.how: component[0] type index on UI GameObjects; plain Transforms differ

rect.how: cached rect {x, y, width, height} in local units: full-screen HUD = (-960, -540, 1920, 1080) at 1920x1080 reference

anchorMin.how: serialized order anchorMin, anchorMax, anchoredPosition, sizeDelta, pivot: (0,0) (1,1) (0,0) (0,0) (0.5,0.5) on a stretched HUD

capacity.how: u32 14608; every array is this long (array gaps = capacity x element size)

localTransforms.how: TransformX {float4 position; float4 rotation (x,y,z,w); float4 scale}: canvas root (800, 450) scale 0.8333 at 1600x900

deepChildCount.how: int, counts the node itself: leaves 1 (VillageHUD's Animation = 3: itself and two children)

nextIndices.how: int: next transform in depth-first order (8821 -> 8822 -> 8823); subtrees are walked along it (they are not always contiguous: ArenaHUD's range had 84 empty slots)
